Medtech rule
sources.rule: A line is kept when its expense type (every account / expense type / subjective column the trust publishes) or its line description matches medical or surgical equipment, consumables or devices: medical, surgical, clinical supplies / consumables / equipment, consumable, dressing, appliance, prosthesis, implant, orthopaedic, device, catheter, syringe, needle, suture, stent, endoscopy, diagnostic, laboratory, pathology, x-ray, radiology, imaging, theatre, wound, ostomy, continence, orthotic, hearing aid, pacemaker, dialysis. It is dropped when the same text also names drugs or medicines, non-clinical, medical gases, staff, pay, agency, locums, salaries, external tests, records, IT, software, estates, buildings, utilities, catering, cleaning, laundry, furniture, office, legal, audit, insurance, travel, training, or consultancy, or when its expense area names drugs or pharmacy, or when the supplier is itself an NHS trust, foundation trust or integrated care board.

rules: One record per Hub trust. For trusts that publish a CSV or spreadsheet, the newest file named on the trust's own page is read and only lines from its newest month are kept, then only lines at or over the trust's threshold and passing the medtech rule. Supplier names and amounts are as published; a line whose amount is not a plain number is dropped and counted. hubCompany is an exact full-name match (case and spacing ignored) to a Hub company name or its Companies House registered name, never partial. PDF, HTML and ODS publishers are recorded as format only.

fieldMeanings.trusts[].publishes: yes / no / unknown / blocked, from the 25/11/2026 survey
fieldMeanings.trusts[].status: parsed, format-only, not-read, no-file-found, columns-not-recognised, file-fetch-or-read-failed, dates-after-today
fieldMeanings.trusts[].latestMonth: newest month in the file read (from its transaction dates, else the link)
fieldMeanings.trusts[].linesAmountUnreadable: lines whose amount was not a plain number (dropped, counted)
fieldMeanings.trusts[].linesDatedAfterToday: lines dated after the run date (dropped; over 10% of the file and the trust publishes none)
fieldMeanings.trusts[].stale: true when the newest month found is more than six months before the run
fieldMeanings.lines[].expenseType: every expense-type / account column the trust publishes for the line, joined with ' | '
fieldMeanings.trusts[].thresholdGBP: 30000 where the trust publishes over £30,000; null = £25,000 not contradicted
fieldMeanings.lines[].amount: amount as published in the trust's amount column, GBP
fieldMeanings.lines[].hubCompany: Hub company name, exact match only, else null
